verdict.rationale: Fly.io runs any Docker image as a fast-booting VM close to users in regions worldwide, so non-JavaScript code can run at the edge; Elixir is explicitly supported. However, this is a container/VM model rather than an edge-functions model, and the evidence never names Python, Go, or Rust. missing for 10: an explicit function-style edge runtime, documented Python/Go/Rust edge support, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can write edge functions in languages other than JavaScript such as Python, Go, or Rust

citations.quote: Fly.io converts Docker images to fast-booting VMs and runs them globally.
Fly Machines are hardware-isolated VMs that boot in under a second, run close to your users
Fly.io makes it easier to run an Elixir cluster on multiple servers around the world and deploy to those regions with a single command.
